channel.title: BRYME — writing opportunities, guides and verification
channel.description: Legitimate paid-writing opportunities, practical guides and BRYME's firsthand verification record.

item.title: Can a Nigerian writer actually get paid by Substack, Medium or Vocal?
item.description: All three platforms pay through Stripe, and Stripe does not pay out to Nigerian bank accounts. Here is what that actually blocks, what it doesn't, and which door is still open.

item.title: Onchain publishing for writers is quietly over
item.description: Mirror pioneered essays as NFTs. Paragraph bought it, shut it down, and has now pivoted to selling AI marketing content to startups. The whole category emptied out in eighteen months.

item.title: Polymemo review — the 49% nobody mentions
item.description: A new Japanese platform pays writers 70% of what readers spend, and readers fund translation into 200+ languages. Read the terms closely and the real cash figure is about 49 cents on the dollar.

item.title: The magazine AI ban is spreading faster than writers realise
item.description: Seven of the 33 publications BRYME verified in September 2026 now prohibit AI-written submissions outright — and the wording is getting stricter, not softer.
